definition.endomorphism: f=2+i on the fixed polarized Q(i)-abelian sixfold
definition.target: W=the two-dimensional rational Weil determinant subspace
definition.formula: q=m1*m2*m3; r=q mod m0; choose unique linear s with s*r=1 mod m0; P=s*q
definition.intrinsic_description: Identity on wedge^6 U and wedge^6 conjugate(U), zero on the other Q(i)-character summands; independent of marking and choice of separating endomorphism.

algebraic_cycle_policy.reason: P(F) is a rational linear combination of flat pullbacks by algebraic isogenies f^k, including k=0.
algebraic_cycle_policy.meaning_of_last_false: Not proved, not a proof of nonvanishing on an actual algebraic cycle of this X.

remaining_equivalence: O kills all codimension-three algebraic cycle classes on the selected X iff W has no nonzero algebraic class iff the selected alpha is nonalgebraic. A single algebraic class with nonzero O-image generates an algebraic representative of alpha using f* and rational coefficients.
witness_conversion: For z=aR+bI nonzero in W, alpha=c*z+d*f*z, with c=(44a+117b)/(44(a^2+b^2)) and d=b/(44(a^2+b^2)).

rejected_uniform_claim.claim: The same construction kills all algebraic cycles on every balanced Q(i)-Weil sixfold of this discriminant.
rejected_uniform_claim.counterexample: At the earlier Z=0 elliptic-product control, R and I are divisor polynomials, yet P(R)=R and P(I)=I.
rejected_uniform_claim.scope: Rejects uniform or purely K-structure/face-coherence vanishing; does not refute annihilation on the fixed transcendental-period X.

coarse_endomorphism_hostile: Using 1+i instead of a separating generator merges the Weil endpoints with mixed character summands; its naive even-character projector has rank 452, not 2, on H^6.
trust_scope: Written cohomology/cycle functoriality and representation arguments, exact polynomial/exterior and witness-conversion controls. Uses previously imported torus geometry; not proof-assistant certification and not a solution of the remaining Weil algebraicity problem.
